name: Compromise Client Software Binary
summary: Adversaries may modify system software binaries to establish persistent access to devices. System software binaries are used by the underlying operating system and users over adb or terminal emulators. Adversaries may make modifications to client software binaries to carry out malicious tasks when those binaries are executed. For example, malware may come with a pre-compiled malicious binary intended to overwrite the genuine one on the device.…

analytics.guidance: For Android, detect Compromise Client Software Binary from documented management, network, or vetting evidence; treat state queries as periodic observations rather than real-time events.
